name: java-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of the Java API, kept locally: the classes of the java.base module (java.lang, java.util, java.io, java.nio, java.time, java.net...) and of java.net.http, from the Javadoc of OpenJDK. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look an API up rather than guess it.
search: Search the Java API documentation of OpenJDK: the java.base module (java.lang, java.util, java.io, java.nio, java.time, java.math, java.net, java.text, java.security) and java.net.http. Returns 10 section ids at most.
